title: Depth-three parity circuit bounds
statement: For every natural number $n$, the parity function on $\\{-1,1\\}^n$, given by the product of all $n$ coordinates, has a depth circuit of depth exactly $3$, size at most $2b\\,2^b$, and width at most $n$, where $b=\\max\\{1,\\lceil n^{1/2}\\rceil\\}$.
